body: Asked in the BewareILive session 2026-10-22 06:08 PDT. Robotron: robotron parent, factory CMOS, the set all 82 stored traces already use. Confirmed: stargate, sinistar, blaster, bubbles, joust2, mysticm, tshoot, splat, inferno.
summary: Canonical sets: Robotron is MAME's parent set robotron at factory settings; the nine unstarted games' proposed sets (each MAME parent at factory settings) are confirmed
